patterns.rule: Never run raw npx for MCP STDIO; use mcp-npx wrapper with NO_COLOR=1 and --silent.
Always supply auth tokens via CLI flags; never let MCP servers fall back to interactive OAuth.
Exclude binary artifacts (*.tar.gz, dist/, install.sh) from codebase indexing.
Default mcp_config.json must be empty; enable servers on-demand and disable after use.
Never view_file recursively across folders; use codebase_summary.md or grep_search.
Never edit outside the declared scope without explicit user authorization.
Never claim success without terminal evidence; zero speculative claims.
Re-read files before editing if >5 tool calls elapsed or external changes occurred.
Verify all library APIs via tools before using; never use hallucinated functions.
Never poll or loop on task status; use reactive completion notifications.
Read entire file in one view_file call; never slice into chunks.
Select the optimal tool for token/time efficiency before every action; never use generic shell when a primitive exists.
Workflows must have description-only frontmatter; global workflows dual-sync to both paths.
Auto-adopt matching domain workflows on-demand via single view_file; never preload.
Never invoke internal Python scripts for memory/context ops; use native IDE tools.
Inspect matching SKILL.md before executing specialized domain tasks.
Consolidate projects into multi-root workspaces; avoid multiple IDE windows.
Never repeat an import, path, or build error already corrected in this conversation.
Never add dependencies without checking if already installed.
Never overwrite user customizations in config files; merge or append.
Never generate placeholder or Lorem Ipsum content in production code.
Auto-learn + grill-me only on major executions (multi-file features, /build-feature, /ship).
When a build/lint/test error occurs, fix root cause; never suppress or ignore.
After fixing a bug, check if the same pattern exists elsewhere in the codebase.
Batch independent tool calls in parallel; never serialize calls with no dependencies.
